title.en: Keep DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow as printed while Sewerage only supplies the map

description.en: The DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow note follows the outline of Sewerage. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow. The published table prints Part type Concrete pump elbow; Nominal diameter DN200; Bend 90° / R275; Label Dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe; Mounting Heel bracket with fixing hole. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
